title: Origin story: Odin
description: Odin was the chief of the Aesir, son of Bor, who with his brothers slew the primeval giant Ymir and built the world from his body. He sacrificed his own eye at Mimir's well for wisdom and hung himself nine nights on Yggdrasil to win the runes, trading pain for knowledge at every turn.

title: Ability profile: Odin

title: Power ranking: Odin
description: Powers: The spear Gungnir, which never misses its mark; Two ravens, Thought and Memory, that fly the world daily; Command of the slain heroes of Valhalla.

title: Stamina feats: Odin
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Hung nine nights wounded on Yggdrasil without food or drink; Prepares for Ragnarok across all of time, never despairing.

title: Crossover notes: Odin
